settings.scope: Every recorded and 2/4 Gauss state; independent source pressure, caloric quantities, stress solution, local/global work/heat/entropy. Union-node time comparison and adiabatic equilibrium endpoint. Finite samples are not continuous-time maxima.

adiabatic_equilibrium.method: Independent simultaneous constant U+pV and mechanical equilibrium, not a second time integrator.
